zollman_verdict: tradeoff DISSOLVED: discovery topology-free (homogeneous probe flat), diffusion helps both speed and accuracy; the wheel converts on the hub-broadcast despite low lambda_2
finding: the network-epistemology speed/accuracy tradeoff is a property of the consensus-only representation (herding under premature pooling). With represented rivals the tradeoff is absent: correct prequential evidence cannot herd, so sparsity buys no accuracy; and when truth must DIFFUSE from a vanguard, connectivity (and hub centrality) help both axes monotonically -- a contagion regime, not a discovery one.
